_note: Ontario fishing-season data served to the app (GET /api/regulations). Edit this file and redeploy the backend to update seasons for everyone — no app release needed. 'reaches' overrides win over 'groups'; each has a 'detail' plus either a static 'state' (open|closed|check) or a date-aware 'group' (a key in 'groups'). River ids match the app's RIVERS data. Encoded from the FMZ 16 regulations at ontario.ca; add other zones / refine boundaries as confirmed.

grand-lower.detail: Grand River below Paris — extended migratory season to Dec 31 (rainbow, brown, Pacific & Atlantic salmon). Lower-river limits apply Oct 1–Dec 31.

credit-lower.detail: Lower Credit (Britannia Rd to Hwy 407) — extended fall migratory season to Dec 31. Atlantic salmon are catch-and-release only.

humber-lower.detail: Lower Humber (Eglinton Ave to Hwy 407) — extended fall migratory season to Dec 31.

rouge-lower.detail: Rouge River — extended fall migratory season to Dec 31.

bronte.detail: Bronte Creek (Lakeshore to Hwy 407, Oakville) — extended fall migratory season to Dec 31.

sixteen.detail: Sixteen Mile Creek (Oakville) — extended fall migratory season to Dec 31.

notty-main.detail: Nottawasaga River main stem — extended fall migratory season to Dec 31 (rainbow, brown, Pacific & Atlantic salmon).

grand-tw.detail: Grand tailwater above Paris — resident-trout season (~4th Sat April to Sept 30). Above Paris: artificial lures only, single barbless hook, catch-and-release for brown & rainbow.

credit-upper.detail: Upper Credit — resident-trout season (~4th Sat April to Sept 30). Above Britannia Rd is a fish sanctuary: no fishing Jan 1 to the Friday before the 4th Sat in April.

credit-mid.detail: Middle Credit (Norval–Glen Williams), above the Hwy 407 extended-season boundary — resident-trout season closes Sept 30. Confirm the exact reach in the regs.

notty-tribs.detail: Nottawasaga cold tributaries — resident-trout season (~4th Sat April to Sept 30). The extended fall season applies to the main river, not these headwater tribs.

boyne.detail: Boyne headwaters — resident-trout season (~4th Sat April to Sept 30).

conestogo-tw.detail: Conestogo tailwater — resident-trout season (~4th Sat April to Sept 30). Not on the extended-fall list.

extendedFall.note: Extended fall migratory season (to Dec 31) on this named river.

atlantic.note: Atlantic salmon are a restoration fishery — often catch-and-release only or closed. Confirm before fishing.
